problem.title: The real problem with *grassroots basketball*
problem.intro: You give everything every weekend. But you're still coaching mostly on instinct.

instinct.title: You coach on instinct
instinct.text: You vaguely remember that "X played well". No numbers to prove it, fix it, or build on it.

blind.title: Your players don't know where they stand
blind.text: They show up to practice with zero feedback in numbers. How do you improve without a mirror?

fog.title: The club runs in a fog
fog.text: The president doesn't know what happens on the court. Neither do the parents. Everything relies on locker-room memory.

free.q: Is it really free for coaches and presidents?
free.a: Yes. Players try it for a month, then decide. No credit card to get started.

tech.q: What if nobody at my club is a "tech" person?
tech.a: One player on the bench is enough. Everything is guided, zero training.

ffbb.q: Does it work with the FFBB?
ffbb.a: Yes. One link is enough: your FFBB schedule is imported, then resynced in one click.

mistakes.q: What if we make a mistake with the stats during the game?
mistakes.a: Every play can be corrected, live or after the game. The history stays clean.

transfer.q: Do my players keep their stats if they change clubs?
transfer.a: Yes. Each player has a single profile. Their stats travel with them.

onboarding.q: How long until we're up and running?
onboarding.a: A demo, setting up the club, a few tests. We're with you from A to Z, and your first game comes fast.

devices.q: Which devices does it work on?
devices.a: iPhone, Android and computer, from the browser. It installs like an app.
